spans.s: AF1758 रुक् अनुगतं पुरीषप्रवर्तनं ruk anugataṁ purīṣapravartanaṁ Painfi; defecation

DG0258 रुक्ष rukṣa Dryness; one of the 20 gurvādi guṇa; caused due activated Vāyu mahābhūta; denotes physiological & pharmacological dryness; manifested by dryness of body parts, stoppage of flow in body channels; pacifies kapha, increases vāta.
AT0272 रुक्षम् rukṣam Dry parching, Poison aggravates the bodily vāyu in virtue of its parching quality.
DG0259 रुक्षणं rukṣaṇaṁ To cause dryness ; emaciation

SV0219 रुक्षान्न् उपाचरेत rukṣānn upācareta Dry food treatment- those who have more of food accumulation in their body, who are unctuous, those suffering from Madhumeha, who have more of kapha in body should be treated with dry food.
